note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9069 Section 5.1 ('Peer Address: Zero-filled. The remote peer address is not applicable.') at HEAD. locRIBPeerHeader (bmp_locrib.go) leaves Address all-zero and writePeerHeader (header.go) copies all 16 bytes directly to wire offsets 10..26. TestLocRIBPeerHeader asserts ph.Address == [16]byte{} and fails on any non-zero octet. Single-polarity annotation holds (no Ze path assigns Peer Address on PeerType=3).
